seoTitle: Connect Instagram to Your GoDaddy Website
metaDescription: Add an Instagram feed to your GoDaddy website using the Website Builder. Learn how to authorize the connection and customize the display settings.
intro: Integrating Instagram into your GoDaddy website can boost your social presence and keep visitors engaged with live feed updates, whether you're running a portfolio, business, or store. This guide walks through adding the integration in GoDaddy Website Builder and customizing how it displays.

steps.heading: Log in to GoDaddy Website Builder
steps.body: Access your GoDaddy Website Builder dashboard to begin adding the Instagram integration to your site.

steps.heading: Add an Instagram section or widget
steps.body: Find the option to add an Instagram feed section or widget within the builder's available elements.

steps.heading: Authorize the link with your Instagram account
steps.body: Connect and authorize your Instagram account so the builder can pull in your posts for display.

steps.heading: Customize the display settings
steps.body: Adjust how many posts show, the layout, and styling so the feed matches the rest of your site's design.

steps.heading: Publish and check the feed updates
steps.body: Publish your changes and confirm that new Instagram posts appear on your site as expected after you post them.

faq.question: Do I need a business Instagram account to connect it?
faq.answer: A business or creator account is generally recommended for the smoothest integration with website builder tools like GoDaddy's.

faq.question: Will the feed update automatically with new posts?
faq.answer: Yes, once connected, the feed is designed to reflect your latest Instagram posts without needing manual updates.

faq.question: Can I customize how many posts are shown?
faq.answer: Yes, the display settings typically let you control the number of posts and their layout on your site.

faq.question: Does this integration work for portfolios and stores alike?
faq.answer: Yes, it's suited to any type of site — portfolio, business, or store — that wants to showcase Instagram content.
